purpose: Draws and edits the Meters line of a Value card: each Meter with its qualifiers and its Human, AI and Instrument lines, each line with its method and source, giving every change up whole through onChange.
namedChanges: Imports: `../../lib/base/planValue` and `../../lib/base/planValueModel` are `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-card-model` (`carryOthers`, `carryRaw`, `qualifierValues`, `scaleQualifierNames`, `withScaleQualifiers` and the types `MeterKind`, `ValueMeter`, checked to be exported there); `../../lib/base/planCard` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-plan-card-facts` (`planSourceEmpty`, `PlanSourceValue`); `./PlanQualifierValue` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-qualifier-value-picker`; the shared pieces above are from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-line-kit`. The symbols are otherwise unchanged.
Comments: none of these symbols carried a name or a tag; the file's header comment is the unit's own.
`tsconfig.json` leaves out `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, which the app's source is not compiled with.
